name: trucking
description: THE LONG HAUL — driving the void. A crossing between regions, rendered as a highway and driven from a cab rather than walked. The corridor synthesises ZONE-shaped cells and hands them to the flight plugin's mapWindow (via its cell-provider seam), so road auto-tiling, biome, buildings and fog come from the one existing derivation. The drive IS the crossing: current_zone stays the void room, and the odometer crossing a node boundary walks the spine and emits zone.entered, so voidwalking's encounters, ghost-traces, hard nodes and teardown all fire untouched. Client sims at 60fps and streams packed telemetry; the server clamps the ODOMETER against elapsed wall-clock rather than re-simulating. Past the corridor's half-width you are bogged, never blocked. Phase 2 adds the rig: a trailer on the fifth wheel with ONE free variable (the articulation angle phi), so jackknife is emergent rather than coded and reversing inverts it for the cost of a sign; weight applied where it physically belongs (rolling resistance stays a constant deceleration, brakes and aero are forces divided by mass, which is why a load lengthens the STOP rather than the roll); brake temperature and fade, so holding a gear down a grade is what keeps the pedal honest; and reverse, geared deeper than first. Cargo needs a trailer, so bobtail is a real way to drive rather than an unfinished one.
